product_one_liner.value: SpotDraft is an AI-native contract lifecycle management platform for legal teams that manages contract intake, drafting, review, negotiation, approvals, e-signatures, and post-signature work in one system.
product_one_liner.notes: SpotDraft describes its product as an AI-native CLM platform for legal teams and lists the contract lifecycle workflows it handles.
